title: Jubilant Uruguayan Red Onion Bowl
description: A floral and silky Uruguayan dish featuring red onions and nuka-pickle, served in a dolsot stone bowl. This satvik-friendly recipe is perfect for a festive occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together chimichurri, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the sliced red onions to the bowl and toss to coat with the chimichurri mixture.
Spread the onions on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together nuka-pickle and dried oregano.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked quinoa in the bottom of a dolsot stone bowl.
Add a spoonful of steamed edamame on top of the quinoa.
Spoon the roasted onions over the edamame.
Drizzle the nuka-pickle mixture over the onions.
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
